texts.zh: 我们收到了一份报告，提到一个亲密盟友[admiral_democracy.GetName]挪动公共资金用于不光彩的个人支出。许多人声称这可能是代其派系行事。如果公众知道这场运动挪用了公共资金为私人服务，那肯定会给他们的民粹主义议程泼冷水。
texts.en: A report has been brought back to us, about the scandalous personal spending of public funds by a close ally of [admiral_democracy.GetName]. Many claim it might have been on behalf of their faction. If the public were to learn this movement has used public funds for themselves, it would surely put a damper on their populist agenda.

label.zh: 我们会保护他们，就这一次。
label.en: We will protect them, just this once.

texts.zh:
经过漫长的调查，他们似乎终于找到了司令部办公室第一起谋杀案的凶手。所有的证据都指向了[admiral_oligarchy.GetName]最亲密的顾问之一，他私自下令暗杀了他们的对手。

虽然[admiral_oligarchy.GetName]没有做错任何事，但如果公众知道了，会对其运动造成不良影响。
texts.en:
After a long-winded investigation, it seems they have finally found the perpetrator of the first murder in the admiralty offices. All evidence points to one of the closest advisors to [admiral_oligarchy.GetName], who personally ordered the assassination of their opponent.

Though [admiral_oligarchy.GetName] is innocent of any wrong-doing, it would reflect poorly on their movement if the public were to know about it.

label.zh: 我们保证他们不会知道的。
label.en: We will make sure they won't know.

label.zh: 所以凶手终于被找到了。
label.en: So the murderer has finally been found then.
